method: Canvas 2D textured triangulated mesh with 3 joint weights per vertex and two-link IK foot contacts. Normalized bind-image landmarks.

scuttle.anatomyNotes: Four legs on each image side; rear inner leg contact tips are partly occluded. First candidate preserved separately; one pose correction separates eight feet.

spool.anatomyNotes: Far image-left rear leg/foot is occluded by the armored utility core in this view. Its estimate is metadata only and excluded from independent bones and pinned contacts.

chime.anatomyNotes: Flying drone: six tucked articulated legs, two layered rigid wing assemblies; no grounded contacts. Root hover and spar hinges provide distinct motion.

skip.anatomyNotes: Four arms must remain distinct: two long blade arms and two smaller inner claws. Planted two-link legs support the lean.

bastion.anatomyNotes: Four heavy legs; far image-left rear limb is partly occluded by the crusher jaw. Keep jaw angle small and planted contacts steady.
